proposals.title: Visibility/navigation and Automation Mode entry branches
proposals.proposed_action: In separate editable Arrangement copies with admitted take lanes, actually invoke the track-header Show Take Lanes context command, the main-lane Show/Hide toggle and the exact offered CtrlAltU(Win)/CmdOptionU(Mac) shortcut in show/hide histories. From an actually selected take lane press Left Arrow and observe main-lane selection/folding. In separately reset Automation Mode histories actually invoke Show and then Insert Take Lane, recording mode/visible lanes; RC045 already does Show, not Insert.
proposals.positive_baseline: UI-only accepted selected take/main context, existing lanes and actual initial visibility/Automation Mode recorded; no audio/hardware required. Before any output/loss observation establish independently productive main and take histories.
proposals.limits: No keyboard focus/OS alias/accessibility/persistence/default or exact fold-animation timing law; left-arrow behavior not arbitrary from every focus.

proposals.title: Lane insert/duplicate/delete actual entry alternatives
proposals.proposed_action: Use disposable copies with known lane/clip identities. Actually insert into one then two selected tracks via separately reset Create menu, track-header context, lane-header context and exact offered ShiftAltT(Win)/ShiftOptionT(Mac). Actually duplicate via header Duplicate and CtrlD/CmdD; delete separately via offered Backspace/Delete and Edit Delete. Independently invoke Delete All Take Lanes, retaining true RC048 Delete All Unused as a separate operation with recorded used/unused material.
proposals.positive_baseline: Known existing editable lane and successful duplicate/insertion before deletion/absence; independently known recorded used and unused source material and genuine main comp before unused classification. UI actions need no audio; audio-loss trials require each take/main actually productive first.
proposals.limits: No physical sample-file deletion, undo grouping, complete unused predicate, cross-track delete/frozen behavior or arbitrary path acceptance; unavailable route stays U.

proposals.title: Resize entry gestures and selected-lane scope
proposals.proposed_action: On one then multiple selected take lanes actually use the offered Alt+(Win)/Option+(Mac), Alt-(Win)/Option-(Mac), modifier+wheel and hover-edge resize handles in separate reset histories. Record selected versus nonselected lane identity/visible height before and after.
proposals.positive_baseline: UI-only admitted editable lane edges and independently offered input route; establish a visible positive size change before a subsequent reset/no-change contrast. No audio/hardware requirement.
proposals.limits: No height pixel/step/minimum/maximum, OS event code, default, persistence or unselected-effect law beyond source selected scope.

proposals.title: Reorder and rename routes/multiselection traversal
proposals.proposed_action: Within one track with distinguishable lanes actually reorder via drag/drop then separately Ctrl/Cmd Up and Down. Actually invoke Edit Rename, header-context Rename and CtrlR/CmdR on reset selected lanes; then separately rename multiple selected lanes and use Tab/ShiftTab while renaming across admitted lanes/tracks. Preserve RC047 category actions.
proposals.positive_baseline: UI-only known lane identities/order and admitted editable names/selection; establish productive reorder/rename once before a no-effect query. No audio required.
proposals.limits: No cross-track reorder, name grammar/uniqueness, exact focus wrap, OS alias, undo/restore or numeric resize law.

proposals.title: Productive recording-take and reuse-history prerequisites
proposals.proposed_action: Retain RC043 complete audio/MIDI over-record passes and RC044 no-clip-after-punch-in reuse. Refine future histories with a separately admitted first-empty-track capture, independently identifiable successive full takes, and actual main playback of the last recorded clip. Record offered lane/clip identities without selecting an allocation order.
proposals.positive_baseline: Each armed eligible track has independently admitted active owned input, accepted recording trigger and genuinely NONEMPTY completed take with NONZERO nonmuted playback. BOTH distinct takes and main comp independently productive before reuse/loss/order comparisons; flags alone cannot supply takes.
proposals.limits: R-G04 partial passes, reuse search order, first-main preservation and R-G05–09 undo/media/restore/cancel/crossfade remain U. No immediate-output deadline or new duplicate recording case adopted.

proposals.title: Actual library/file-to-take insertion and multiple-sample track destination
proposals.proposed_action: On admitted audio/MIDI tracks actually drag one owned supported sample and one admitted MIDI file to a take lane from Browser, then separately from platform Explorer/Finder. With multiple known samples selected, hold Ctrl(Win)/Cmd(Mac) while dragging and record the sequential TRACK destinations, not sequential take lanes.
proposals.positive_baseline: Known valid owned NONEMPTY files, admitted drop targets and genuine successful loaded clip/output history before replacement/cancel/absence. MIDI/audio admission separate; actual output requires independently productive instrument/route/nonzero gain. UI-only location observations need no audio.
proposals.limits: No decoder/format grammar/universal admission, multi-MIDI distribution, sample ordering, transaction/cancel or file-copy law; source creative suggestion does not guarantee a preferred sound.

proposals.title: Audition entry routes and last-selected lane per track
proposals.proposed_action: With audition explicitly off establish main playback, then actually invoke a lane speaker button and separately T on reset copies. Retain true RC049 same-track switching and RC050 different-track simultaneous audition. In separate histories form a time selection then a lane-header selection spanning multiple take lanes on DIFFERENT tracks, with recorded selection order; invoke audition and inspect last selected lane per track.
proposals.positive_baseline: BOTH distinct identifiable takes on each tested track AND its main comp independently have genuine NONEMPTY NONZERO nonmuted productive output before switching/loss; each track productive separately before simultaneous audition. UI-only button/selection checks need no audio.
proposals.limits: No constructor/default reset, universal main-suppression-at-boundaries, switch latency, gap/tail/no-click, note codec or all-stopped output law; unavailable T focus remains U.

proposals.limits: Existing Arrangement/Session/clip owners retain edit, launch and file laws; no all-edit completion, exact move/copy ownership transaction or duplication of physical media inferred.
